text:
Marta: Heads-up — AcmeRetail is seeing a spike of 503s on Dedicated pool. SLA at risk. Can someone own triage and customer comms? Ticket ACME-827.

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-041 and a bridge opened. See /incidents for details.

Samir: Which pool/route exactly? any recent deploys or config changes?

Marta: Mostly `dedicated-prod-3`, route `/v1/generate`. p99 latency + 503s started ~09:12 UTC, customer reports ~09:15. No obvious load surge from their side.

Elaine: I rolled a tiny kernel tweak to pool-3 at ~09:10 to address quantization perf. Rolling back if that's the culprit. @Andrew can you confirm if that tweak increases memory for long sequences?

Andrew: Looking at node metrics — seeing OOMs on gpu-3a correlating with the deploy. The kernel change bumps peak mem by ~200MB for long seqs. Starting rollback of that rollout now.

Samir: I'll take mitigation ownership for routing/scale while Andrew rolls back. Will pause any autoscaler drains.

Marta: ETA on rollback? I need to give AcmeRetail an ETA for recovery.

Andrew: Rollback in progress (manual revert of kernel patch). Should be finished in ~8-12m. Canary rollout to one node first, then pool. I'll post PR link and rollout notes.

oncall-bot: Deploy rollback started by Andrew at 3789123490; status: in_progress.

Elaine: After rollback we should validate KV cache warm-up. If traffic still noisy, we can short-term route AcmeRetail traffic to `dedicated-prod-1`. @Samir can you open a route override as fallback?

Samir: Yep — will create a route override for customer tag `acmeretail` -> `dedicated-prod-1`. Plan: apply 5m after rollback completes to avoid flapping.

Marta: I've messaged AcmeRetail with a holding ETA and that we're rolling back a recent kernel change. They're asking for a postmortem once we're stable.

Andrew: Rollback completed at 3789123554. No new OOM events on gpus. Monitoring p99 and 503s now.

Samir: Route override applied at 3789123560. Traffic shifted to prod-1 for the affected customer. Dropping burst capacity to avoid cascade.

Elaine: Confirming sample requests — latency and success rate look back to normal. I'll collect perf logs and kernel config diff.

Marta: Thanks all. Action items: Andrew — add PR + rollout notes (rollback revert link), Samir — route rule and short follow-up to autoscaler, Elaine — perf logs + draft postmortem. Owning the follow-up for 24h: Samir & Elaine. :thumbsup:

Andrew: PR (revert) link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123 — will append rollout timeline.

Samir: Filed bug ACME-828 to track autoscaler interplay and guardrails; assigned to eng-sre. I'll update ACME-827 with mitigation timeline.

Marta: I'll pull everything into incident summary and ping cs to schedule a follow-up with the customer. Good job moving fast.

Elaine: Adding perf diffs and a short checklist to prevent similar rollouts from hitting dedicated pools without a canary window.

Samir: Leaving a note: if we see reappearance, escalate directly to eng-sre oncall and we’ll cut traffic immediately.

Marta: Closing this thread for now — will reopen if anything regresses. Thanks team.
